posts.text: “Good morning. It’s Thursday. Thumb guy has figured out an acceptable protocol while I’m on injured reserve. He takes Zoë for a very long patrol while I sleep in. Then when he gets back, he and Zoë escort me out for a short walk, then treats and breakfast. Then belly rubs. Also, I love you.”

The best thing about this angle?

When it’s complete, the “Sponsored By Brawndo” banner will look like it’s hanging over the White House.
